lines.text: Jesus, the apostle and high priest, was faithful to the One who appointed Him, just as Moses was faithful.
Jesus has been counted worthy of greater glory than Moses, who was faithful as a servant in God's house.
The fathers tested God and saw His works for seven years, so He swore they would never enter His rest.
Exhort one another daily so none is hardened, and we share in Christ if we hold firmly to the end.
Those who heard and rebelled were all those Moses led out of Babylon, and unbelief kept them from entering.
